public_auto_str_83:
Operation Guide
Reload configuration (Reload): Smoothly load the latest configuration. The process re-reads the configuration without disconnecting the existing connection, achieving zero business interruption. It is recommended to use it after daily modification of the configuration.
Restart service (Restart): Forcefully terminate and restart all processes. It will cause ongoing requests (such as order submission, file upload) to be interrupted momentarily and throw a 502 error. It is only used in rare cases of abnormal recovery.
